messages.subject: Any luck getting sampling() running on Jupyter notebook?
parts:
Hi all, 

I'm running a simple model in a Jupyter notebook. It compiles fine, but then throws a segfault during sampling(). The model runs fine in R Studio. 

From my reading so far this seems like a problem with Jupyter, though I thought I'd ask here on the off chance anyone had had the same problem/found a work-around. 

Jim
